She stands relaxed, arms at her sides, on a quiet wet cobblestone street lined with pale stone townhouses and one dark green door, late afternoon, soft overcast light. She stands on a quiet wet cobblestone street lined with pale stone townhouses and one dark green door, late afternoon, soft overcast light. Eye-level, 35mm. Both hands visible.

rel: 01-景别/教学/图/L01-01-中景.jpg

rel: 01-景别/教学/图/L01-01-近景.jpg

rel: 01-景别/教学/图/L01-01-大特写.jpg

rel: 01-景别/教学/图/L01-01-中近景.jpg

rel: 01-景别/教学/图/L01-02-远景孤独.jpg

rel: 01-景别/教学/图/L01-02-近景亲密.jpg

rel: 01-景别/教学/图/L01-03-切点正确.jpg

The bottom of the frame cuts cleanly across the waist, through the soft area of the torso between ribcage and hip, clearly not through the navel-belt joint line and not through the elbows. rel: 02-景深与焦段/教学/图/L02-05-移轴.jpg

rel: 02-景深与焦段/教学/图/L02-05-分屈光镜.jpg

rel: 03-构图/教学/图/L03-01-中心构图.jpg
caption: 中心构图 · 正面直视，观众无处可逃

rel: 03-构图/教学/图/L03-01-黄金路线.jpg
caption: 黄金比例的用法 · 大块安静区把眼睛送到一个亮点

rel: 03-构图/教学/图/L03-01-地平线在上.jpg

rel: 03-构图/教学/图/L03-01-视觉重心.jpg

rel: 03-构图/教学/图/L03-02-汇聚引导线.jpg
caption: 汇聚引导线 · 所有线把眼睛送到她身上

rel: 03-构图/教学/图/L03-02-S形曲线.jpg

rel: 03-构图/教学/图/L03-02-框中框-聚焦.jpg
caption: 框中框 · 聚焦：框内亮，框外暗
prompt: Frame within a frame. Camera looks through a dark doorway. The door frame is a black rectangle. Inside, a warmly lit room, and she stands centered in the bright inner frame, charcoal coat, cream scarf. The area outside the door is dark. The frame says look here.

rel: 03-构图/教学/图/L03-02-对角线.jpg
caption: 对角线 · 眼睛从一角斜穿到另一角

rel: 03-构图/教学/图/L03-02-框中框-窥视.jpg

rel: 03-构图/教学/图/L03-02-框中框-困住.jpg

rel: 03-构图/教学/图/L03-02-前景遮挡.jpg
caption: 前景遮挡 · 隔着门边和植物看进去

rel: 03-构图/教学/图/L03-03-对称仪式.jpg

rel: 03-构图/教学/图/L03-03-对称压迫.jpg

rel: 03-构图/教学/图/L03-03-一点透视空镜.jpg

rel: 03-构图/教学/图/L03-03-对称喜剧.jpg

rel: 03-构图/教学/图/L03-03-消失点上的人.jpg

rel: 03-构图/教学/图/L03-03-打破对称.jpg

rel: 03-构图/教学/图/L03-04-负空间威胁.jpg

rel: 03-构图/教学/图/L03-04-两人之间的空.jpg
